parole.significato: A relaxed, carefree attitude associated with the Indian state of Goa.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Konkani सुसेगाद (susegād), from Portuguese sossegado (“quiet”).

parole.significato: A kind of drama genre of Goa, usually in the Konkani language.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Konkani तियात्र (tiyātra), from Portuguese teatro. Doublet of theater.

parole.significato: A blend of chilis, tamarind, ginger, cumin, and mustard seeds, originally from Goa.
parole.testo: From Konkani विंदालू (vindālū), from Portuguese vin-d’alho (“wine and garlic sauce”), from vinho (“wine”) + alho (“garlic”). Not related to English aloo, from Hindi आलू (ālū), but by confusion with this term the dish is often based on potatoes.
